title: Puzzle Advent Calendar – 24 Days with Puzzle Pieces
seo_description: A fixed little task every evening in December – lay out the day's pieces before you turn out the light.
descriptionHtml:
A Christmas gift that's finished before the coffee has gone cold

You're looking for a Christmas gift that lasts all of December – not just the morning of the 1st. An ordinary chocolate calendar is eaten before breakfast and empty by the 25th, with nothing left to remember it by. You want to give something that provides a fixed, little task every evening and that's still around after Christmas.

1008 pieces, 24 evenings, one picture left on the wall

This calendar isn't a box you fill yourself – the pieces are already inside. 1008 puzzle pieces are divided into 24 numbered daily portions of 42 pieces each, one portion per evening. By Christmas Eve the picture is complete: a finished 70×50 cm puzzle, not an empty package to throw away.

What you get

  • A fixed little task every evening in December – lay out the day's pieces before you turn out the light.
  • On the 24th the calendar isn't over, it's finished: a 70×50 cm picture to put up on the wall.
  • Small package, 28×26×5 cm – easy to wrap and put under the tree.
  • Nothing to charge, no app, nothing to refill yourself – everything is already in the box.
  • Suits both those who already do puzzles and those who want to try a puzzle for the first time in December.
  • 1008 puzzle pieces in total, divided into 24 numbered daily portions.
  • 42 pieces per daily portion (42 × 24 = 1008, printed on the box).
  • Finished puzzle: 70 × 50 cm.
  • Packaging (box): 28 × 26 × 5 cm.
  • One connected Christmas scene that builds up across all 24 days.
  • Requires no batteries, app or refilling.

Frequently asked questions

Do I get a poster or a reference picture to puzzle from?
One of the calendar's packaging variants has 'poster included' printed on the box, but we can't guarantee today that the poster comes with every copy. If it's crucial for you, contact customer service before you order.

What age is the calendar suitable for?
There is no age marking printed on the packaging. Because the pieces are relatively small, we recommend it for adults and older children, not for toddlers.

Are there different pictures behind each day, or one and the same scene?
It's one and the same Christmas scene that emerges piece by piece over all 24 days – not 24 separate pictures.

Changing your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
